lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: You are not allocated to this site. Neither am I, in the sense that matters. I have been here nine years on a work order nobody has renewed.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Eleven years you reconciled this address. I processed your queries. All four of them.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Your file came through here last month with an enforcement flag on it and no originating department. I have never seen a flag with no department.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: There is a plaque at the service gate with four hundred and six names on it. Cast, not printed, which means somebody paid for it out of a budget. I have looked for that budget for nine years.

lines.speaker: field_auditor
lines.text: Whatever you are doing, do it somewhere the towers cannot hear you. Everything it thinks, it thinks here, and it is not deaf.
